systems.country_label: CAPI tablets, APN cards, UBOS data centre and e-recruitment system
systems.platform: CSPro on tablets, MTN and Airtel APN cards
systems.tiers: 121,240 tablets distributed through Local Governments to enumerators for the May 2024 census and retrieved afterwards; District/City IT Officers sat on census committees; local governments recruited staff through the UBOS e-recruitment system

note: The census report: its ICT is the statistics bureau's own, lent to the field for enumeration, and nothing is stated on the connection of a local government office. It gives the count of 135 districts and 11 cities at May 2024. The capture is an excerpt, cut off in chapter 2.
